custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Your role can see reports (Admin: Page Access > Reports on).
  • Needs no test data of its own; restore the filter at the end.
  • For the comparison in step 9: a sign-in to production (app.shopview.com) that can see Reports. You only look there; nothing is changed.

Setup

  1. Click Reports in the top menu > Inventory Value. Set Category back to its default if it was changed.
  2. Check the setup worked: the Category button shows its default value.
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top menu.
  2. In the PARTS group click "Inventory Value".
  3. Open the Category filter. Note that "All categories" is ticked.
  4. Click one option. Write down what happens to the ticks and to the report.
  5. Click the same option again. Write down what happens.
  6. Click the "All categories" box. Write down what happens; if it is already ticked, click it once more and write that down too.
  7. Look for a Clear selection button (write down whether there is one, and its words). If there is one, click it and write down what happens.
  8. Close the filter and set Category back to "All categories".
  9. In another browser tab sign in to production (app.shopview.com) and repeat steps 1 to 8 on the same report. Compare each step with what you wrote down.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every step behaves the same on this build as on production (step 9): the same ticks change, the report narrows and widens the same way, and the same buttons are offered.
  • Clicking an option changes which options are ticked, and the report updates to match. (Production today: with "All categories" ticked, clicking an option selects only that option and the button reads "1 selected"; clicking it again goes back to "All categories".)
  • "All categories" ticks every option; clicking it while it is ticked unticks every option. (Production has no separate Clear selection button; clicking the ticked "All categories" box clears the selection.)
  • No error message appears.
  • Mark Failed only if this build behaves differently from production in any step (QA lead's ruling below).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, Medium 7; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), hotspot 5; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.
  • QA lead's ruling, 12 Oct 2026 06:48 UTC, his own result comment on this test in run 498 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/tests/view/3792556), word for word: “Marking as Passed since the Production and the QA environment behaves the same.” His standing rule of the same day (Rule 121): “any issue which is the same on production too is not a regression”. The production comparison was added and the out-of-date “What you should see today” note removed on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply 7: “The filter option list now supports disabled options. Check that options toggle normally and that Select all and Clear selection work.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/10/2026; production compared by the QA lead on 10/12/2026.
